title: 6515-- PATIENT CEILING LIFTS (607-26-1-969-0014)
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.252-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 12 (36C252)
description_text: Presolicitation The VA Great Lakes Acquisition Center intends to issue RFQ 36C25226Q0373 for Ceiling Lifts for William S. Middleton VAMC in Madison, WI. This firm-fixed price solicitation is being conducted in accordance with FAR Part 13 Simplified Acquisition Procedures and the corresponding NAICS Code is 339113. Please see RFQ document 36C25226Q0373 for requirements. Offerors are to follow the instructions in RFQ document 36C25226Q0373. An itemized quote as well as sufficient technical supporting documentation is mandatory. This supporting documentation will be used to determine whether or not the quoted items meet the requirements of the solicitation. Quotes are due no later than 12p.m. Central, June 5, 2026. Telephone calls will not be accepted. All quotes are to be sent via email to mack.taylor2@va.gov.
